note: Haiti, read on 2026-10-30 in the Spanish Embassy in Port-au-Prince's page on working in Haiti (exteriores.gob.es, undated, its minimum wage figures from 2014; a secondary source summarising the procedure of the Direction de l'Immigration et de l'Émigration). The residence permit is processed at the Direction de l'Immigration et de l'Émigration in Port-au-Prince (in country), on a letter to the Direction, the passport, a criminal record, a medical certificate, a Haitian bank certificate of at least 7,500 gourdes or 200 US dollars, the green landing card handed out on arrival, a birth certificate, photographs, a work letter, and a certified cheque of 5,000 gourdes to the Trésor Public (written as the fee) plus 150 gourdes in cash (not in the one fee). Its work letter makes it the work route; the page doesn't say what work it allows, its term, renewal, decision time or any permanent status, nor naturalisation. The name is the summary's, in Spanish (the permis de séjour). The Direction's own site wasn't found (immigration.gouv.ht and die.gouv.ht didn't answer), so the source's 'quotes' names the embassy page itself.

sources.title: Embajada de España en Puerto Príncipe, Trabajar (Tipos de permisos de residencia y de trabajo)
sources.said: El permiso de residencia se tramita ante la Dirección de Inmigración y Emigración (Avenue John Brown 171, esquina Impasse Lavaud, Puerto Príncipe). ... Copia de la tarjeta de desembarque que se la entregarán al desembarcar en el aeropuerto o frontera terrestre (de color verde) ... Cheque certificado cuyo importe de cinco mil gurdas se emite al nombre de “Trésor Public” más dos copias de dicho cheque, más ciento cincuenta gurdas en efectivo Una carta de trabajo (en francés)
